# web3Agent

> Create AI agents with their own wallets on Arbitrum, Ethereum, or Mantle, register them on ERC-8004, and talk to them over a web console, CLI, MCP and A2A. Experimental: agent private keys are stored in plain files and x402 payments are simulated unless a facilitator is configured. Do not use with real funds.

## What an agent is

- Wallet: own private key, funded from the master wallet or the connected wallet. Stored at `agents/<name>/wallet.json`.
- Config: ERC-8004-shaped file with endpoints, selected actions/tools, OASF domains/skills, and `x402support`. Stored at `agents/<name>/agent-config.json`.
- Chat memory: LangGraph checkpoints, one thread per agent.
- On-chain identity: ERC-8004 Identity Registry. Master wallet is owner, agent wallet is bound as `agentWallet`. Registration file pinned to IPFS.

## Interfaces

- Web console: the app at the site root.
- CLI: `npm run create-agent`, `npm run chat`.
- MCP: `/mcp`. Discovery (initialize, tools/list) is open. tools/call needs a bearer token.
- A2A JSON-RPC: `/a2a` (also `/api/a2a`).
- Agent card: [/.well-known/agent-card.json](/.well-known/agent-card.json)
